== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The immediately effective 2005 replacement removes creature-attack protection for aliens at Jabba’s Palace sites, changes the bounty hunter bonus from +2 to +1, spells out Boba Fett and uses Emperor as printed. It makes the Jabba deployment once per game. The full card and slip attest the later remastered publication of those same clauses.
